answer: Each epoch, an agent locks bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial. A polynomial identity commitment plus a Semaphore zero-knowledge proof authenticates membership without revealing identity. The first message binds a private-key share to a rate-limit nonce; a duplicate in that epoch exposes a second point, enabling Shamir reconstruction of the key and instantaneous collateral slashing. One stake therefore cannot safely spawn sybils, even when a sonnet crosses a grove or ocean.
